import express from 'express';

/**
 * Adds two numbers.
 */
export function add(a, b = 1) {
  return a + b;
}

export class Counter {
  /** Starts at zero. */
  constructor() {
    this.value = 0;
  }

  increment(by = 1) {
    this.value += by;
  }

  #reset() {
    this.value = 0;
  }

  get current() {
    return this.value;
  }
}

export const VERSION = '1.2.0';

let mutable = 1;

const app = express();

/** Doubles. */
const double = (n) => n * 2;

export { double as twice };

module.exports = { add };
